name: Spartans
description: The Spartans were a Latino (Mexican) street gang founded around 1958 in the Heart of Chicago neighborhood (Lower West Side), active along 18th Street near 18th and Damen and 18th and Wood, with a gathering spot at Harrison Park. They were allies of the Morgan Deuces and Latin Counts, and rivals of the Rampants, Ambrose, Satan Disciples, and Gaylords. The gang went extinct in the late 1970s to early 1980s.
